title: An arc whose bulge carries a wheel into tower 1's zone, with both ends outside
rationale: At C = 180 the right support follows the tool's 210-degree arc 51 mm above and 205 mm to the left. Its arc dips to (134.6, 134.6), 8 mm inside Z1(150) grown by m_tower, geom_tol and rho (safety-model 5.1), while both ends of the arc are 57 mm outside and the whole arc stays 5 mm inside WA_wheel. A vertex-only test misses it (spec 08: arc bulges are checked only if stored as many small segments). The robot profile has its tower base measured (40 mm), so B-TOWER does not fail first.
